name: Fumi
source:
A woman who runs a flower shop in Central. She is a kind old woman.

She loves flowers and spends her days being gentle with them.

Despite this, she may be the strongest person in town.

"Oh, welcome. How about tea?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
